description: Add comprehensive tests for the TopicHub model, knowledge graph service, authority generator service, and API endpoints. Tests must mock MongoDB/Beanie and Vertex AI calls.
steps: Create apps/backend/tests/test_topic_hub.py with tests covering: (1) TopicHub model creation and validation - verify all fields can be set and model_dump works. (2) TopicSource, TopicMCQ, TopicPYQ, TopicRelation sub-model validation. (3) Mock-based tests for knowledge_graph_service methods (get_related_topics, get_prerequisite_chain, get_topic_cluster) using unittest.mock.patch on TopicHub.find_one and TopicHub.find. (4) Mock-based tests for authority_generator_service.generate_mcqs mocking vertex_client.generate to return valid JSON. (5) API endpoint tests using FastAPI TestClient with mocked DB calls - test GET /api/v1/topics/{slug} returns 200 with hub data, returns 404 for missing slug. (6) Admin endpoint tests mocking _validate_admin_session.
Follow the existing test pattern from tests/test_knowledge.py: use pytest fixtures, unittest.mock.AsyncMock for async methods, patch decorators.
Run the test suite and confirm all new tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: apps/backend/tests/test_topic_hub.py exists with at least 8 test functions
All tests pass when run with pytest
Tests cover model validation, service logic, and API endpoint responses
Tests properly mock external dependencies (Vertex AI, MongoDB)
